description: baseline sanity A/B: candidate (e9a9cee7) vs pinned base, identical app code

asi.note: SANITY BASELINE, not an experiment: candidate and baseline are the same code, so expected delta is 0. Measured +19.17MB = the run-to-run NOISE FLOOR on this machine. Per-run main RSS medians ranged 112-226MB across 6 identical runs (order A,B,B,A,A,B = 231.6/209.1/198.2/193.0/178.0/145.4). RSS decays through the 60s window (progressive GC); medians land mid-decay and the decay varies per run. Mitigations: run the loop on a quiet machine, or raise --runs; until then treat |delta| < 20MB as noise.
harness_gotchas: electron-builder asar-packs the repo dir; never store app bundles inside the repo (an early baseline copy embedded in the candidate inflated RSS ~18MB)
short settle (15s) samples a GC transient; settle 120s is required
harness MIN_AB_RUNS=3, so 1-run screens are impossible

description: fresh noise-floor A/B (prod Orca closed): candidate vs pinned base, identical code

asi.note: NOISE FLOOR re-measure with prod Orca closed. main_rss_delta_mb=+17.43MB vs prior floor +19.17MB - barely improved; noise is NOT dominated by prod Orca. Per-run main RSS medians (A,B,B,A,A,B): 244.1/127.4/107.7/124.6/117.9/124.5. Run 0 (A) is a clear outlier: median 244MB, main process stays high through window; runs 1-5 cluster 108-127MB. RSS decay-through-window confirmed again (last << boot). The first spawn after sweep appears inflated - cold-cache/warmup effect. Delta driven almost entirely by that one run.
asi.recommendation: host-noise fixes help less than hoped; the dominant term is first-run warmup. Mitigate via a discard-first warmup run in measure.sh, or discard the max-abs side-median outlier before computing delta.

description: clean noise floor: harness fix + warmup (MIN_AB_RUNS-compliant) + no UI interaction

asi.note: CLEAN FLOOR after harness group-kill fix (c229b706), warmup discard (3-run short-settle A/B), and no UI interaction during runs. |delta|=15.38MB, down from 17.4/22.9. Per-run medians: 172.0/168.5/205.6/128.9/170.0/175.6 - still +-38MB half-spread, no warmup outlier (fix worked). The -15.38 is noise, NOT signal (identical app code). Spread across per-run medians remains the dominant uncertainty: single 3-run A/B cannot resolve <40MB deltas reliably. CPU metric wired: main_cpu_delta_pct=0.011 (noise-level).
asi.recommendation: half-spread of per-run medians (~38MB) >> any plausible optimization delta. Either raise runs to 5+ per invocation, or switch primary metric to something stabler (phys_footprint via /usr/bin/footprint, see research notes).
